basic_profile.bio: A dedicated K-pop enthusiast hailing from Sacramento, California. I've been following the K-pop scene since the early 2000s, with a particular interest in solo vocalists and their discographies. I work as a digital marketing specialist, which gives me the flexibility to explore my hobbies during off-peak hours. I'm usually online during late evenings, as my daytime hours are occupied by work and occasional cycling trips. I'm currently in a long-term relationship with someone who shares my love for music and travel.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Communications and a minor in Musicology, I've cultivated a deep understanding of music trends, particularly within the K-pop industry. My expertise is further enhanced by years of self-study and active participation in music forums and online communities.
